It is not a style reference: for style, look at the figure it was written from (assets/exemplars/ai/figures/acl25-0048_fig1/) and at the exemplars the user picks for your own figure.
meta.title: KG-Agent: the agent loop on one question, and how its tuning data is synthesized

system.name: KG-Agent
system.one_liner: an autonomous agent framework in which a small instruction-tuned LLM reasons over a knowledge graph by calling tools step by step, with a knowledge memory updated at each step; its tuning data is synthesized from query graphs

materials: the paper's llama mascot for the Planner (a bitmap the authors supply; a library robot head otherwise)
the toolbox and executor icons (flat-colour bitmaps the authors supply)
the real question, its answer, and the four function calls with their results
the query graph of the question and the two tuning pairs derived from it
the Freebase, YAGO and Wikidata logos (the authors' to reproduce)
ai.notes: two full-width bands split by a dashed rule. Top band: the question and the planner's bubbles at the left, the actor triangle (planner, toolbox, executor) under them, the knowledge-memory table in the middle, the four-step trace at the right with a small planner and executor icon per row. Bottom band: the query graph at the left, the colour-coded reasoning program in the middle, two input-output tuning cards at the right, joined by coloured and black dashed arrows.

meta.caption_draft: Figure 1. Top: KG-Agent answers a question by iterating, for t = 1 ... 4: the Planner reads the knowledge memory, picks a tool from the Toolbox, the Executor runs it on the KG and returns the result, and the memory is updated. Bottom: instruction-tuning data is synthesized by grounding a query graph on the KG, converting it to a KG reasoning program and splitting the program into input-output pairs.
open_questions: Is the knowledge memory read by the planner at every step, or only after the executor returns (one arrow or two)?
Should all four trace steps be drawn, or two steps and an ellipsis with the count?
meta._notes: Captured: the actor triangle as an agent-loop idiom (three large named icons joined by block arrows, planner -> toolbox -> executor -> planner), the memory as a memory-store node, the trace as four text nodes in a container with plain step markers t=1 ... t=4, the question and the answer as bubbles, the query graph as a small container of graph nodes with labelled edges, the reasoning program as a code text node, the two tuning pairs as text cards, and the colour code that ties each graph region to its program lines (one colour per reasoning step, carried into the legend). Not captured as geometry: the dashed horizontal rule between the bands, the exact column widths of the memory table, the small icons repeated in every trace row (the plan repeats the actor icons at label size).
